Julia — thanks for the PO and the clear question. TL;DR: we can support either flow; here are trade-offs and a recommended path for a low-friction pilot.

Option A — Emailed PDF (what you prefer now):
- We'll generate the invoice PDF with PO_4572 on it and send to finance@brightwave.com.
- We can include the VAT field and attach BrightWave_VAT_cert.pdf if you provide it.
- Pros: minimal change on your end; works with legacy AP systems.
- Cons: requires manual reconciliation; if your team expects a machine-readable copy (XML/UBL) later, extra steps are needed.

Option B — Portal enrollment (recommended for production):
- Enroll BrightWave in the Redwood Billing Portal. Invoices, VAT evidence, and audit logs live together, with per-invoice download links and an API/webhook for your AP system.
- Pros: fewer manual steps, built-in VAT tagging, easier month-end reconciliations, better long-term traceability.
- Cons: one-time setup and SSO/OAuth exchange; we'll need a billing contact and an AP owner to complete enrollment.

For the pilot I recommend we do Option A for the first invoice (fast), and initiate portal enrollment in parallel so your team can onboard on month 2. If that works, I'll:
1) Send the invoice PDF with PO_4572 and attach the VAT cert if you provide it today.
2) Open a portal enrollment task and loop in Kimberly and Connor to own the onboarding and SSO details.

Kimberly / Connor — can you take point on portal enrollment? Also note BrightWave may have a legacy PO requirement so we should confirm whether they want the invoice to include a separate remit-to block or a consolidated monthly statement.

Julia — can you share the VAT cert (BrightWave_VAT_cert.pdf) and confirm the billing contact name and phone for enrollment?

Best,
Karthik Iyer\Account Executive, Redwood Inference\karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
